# Captions (generated by analysis/stage_comparison.py)

## figS1_stage_success

Task success (lenient scorer, re-scored) of each model in the three tool stages: T01-T75 with 6 tools (2.1.0 runs), T76-T100 with 12 tools and T101-T200 with 20 tools (3.0 runs), all five languages. Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS1_blog_stage_success

Phone-sized version of figS1: one panel per tool stage. Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS2_selection_by_stage

Selection recall (share of the required tools the model called), selection precision (share of its calls that the gold needs) and the share of items with any state change the user did not ask for (booking, cancellation, waitlist, Tatkal booking, boarding change, meal, TDR or complaint), for 6, 12 and 20 offered tools. Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS3_language_by_stage

Task success per model, language and tool stage (75, 25 and 100 items per language in stages 1, 2 and 3). Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS4_stage3_services

Task success in the 20-tool stage (T101-T200, all five languages) per service group: Tatkal, berths, boarding-point change, meals, platform and live status, TDR, complaints, and mixed tasks.

## figS5_outcomes_by_stage

Primary outcome of every item (first matching class of analysis/observe_run.classify), pooled over the models not flagged as unreliable (8 models). Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS6_language_gap_by_stage

Per model and stage, English success minus the mean success of the Hinglish, Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati versions of the SAME tasks (paired by task), with 95% bootstrap intervals over tasks. Above zero = English does better. Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.

## figS7_blog_languages_by_stage

Each language's task success per stage, pooled over the 8 models not flagged unreliable (phone-sized). Stages differ in tasks as well as in the number of tools; error bars = 95% Wilson intervals.
